error[ZBX-E0102]: kernel version is unsupported or unknown
  cause  zbx needs Linux 5.15 or newer: overlayfs mounts in user namespaces
         arrived in 5.11, and 5.15 is the oldest long-term kernel that has them
  fix    upgrade to Linux 5.15 or newer
  more   zbx explain E0102 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
